canonical_title: Lovable raises $400M Series C at $13.3B valuation
treatment: Do not repeat the funding round or valuation. Reinclude only for a new financing event, material product/model release, independently verified adoption/revenue change, acquisition/IPO event, or other hard operational delta.
known_facts: Lovable raised $400 million in Series C funding at a $13.3 billion valuation, double its December valuation.
Menlo Ventures and the EQT-managed Scaleup Europe Fund co-led the round; Tencent, Balderton Capital and other new investors also participated.
Lovable said annual recurring revenue had nearly tripled from $200 million and was tracking toward $600 million by the end of August 2026.
Lovable said users had created more than 60 million projects and Lovable-built apps attracted more than 900 million visits per month.
The company plans to hire heavily in machine learning, product, infrastructure and security.
reinclude_only_if: A new funding, acquisition, IPO, or material valuation event occurs.
Lovable releases a materially new model, agent system, runtime, or enterprise product.
Independent evidence materially changes the interpretation of its revenue, adoption, or production reliability.
